summary.text: Tim Wadsworth, a Republican, has represented District 14 in the Alabama House of Representatives since November 2014 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: He received a B.S. in accounting and an M.Acc. from the University of Alabama and a J.D. from the Cumberland School of Law at Samford University.
His professional experience includes serving as a certified public accountant and practicing tax law.
